name: A Boar's Vitality
label: Quest
description: A Boar's Vitality: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Within these blasted lands exists two species of boar: the ash-mane boar and the helboar.
It would appear that the stamina of these beasts renders them nearly immune to harm, as the other animals find them too difficult to kill and consequently, not worth the effort.

We need to perform further analysis, friend. Should you bring me three blasted boar lungs, two scorpok pincers, and one basilisk brain, I shall create a divine elixir from the residue of the assay. You will be my first test subject!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The spirit of the boar illuminates your being, friend! I wonder, do you believe yourself to be as invulnerable as these beasts?
